admin_only_note: The TopCleanupOpportunityCard fetches via txGet→admin/transportation/intelligence/cleanup-signals which requires X-Admin-Token. The dashboard route /admin/transportation is itself admin-gated at the route level. For any non-admin (e.g., dispatch) user the underlying endpoint returns 401 and the widget renders the silent fallback testid `tx-dashboard-top-cleanup-error` (no opportunity card surfaced). This satisfies the admin-only constraint.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The /sign-in and /admin/login HTML forms did not authenticate via Playwright form submission (form submit on the SPA appears to need a real React onChange event sequence). Workaround that worked reliably: call POST /api/auth/multi-login via page.evaluate(fetch) and set localStorage keys 'masci.directory.token', 'masci.directory.user', 'masci.admin.token' before navigating to /admin/transportation. Both /admin/transportation (dashboard) and /admin/transportation/intelligence/cleanup (Cleanup Companion tab) load promptly with that pattern. The dashboard card is below the HR Health Widget — scroll-to-bottom before assertion. Use wait_for_load_state='domcontentloaded' (not 'networkidle'; networkidle times out on this SPA due to long-poll connections).
